newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CARTER HOLT SAYS PRICES IMPROVING IN Q2.
newsitem.headline: CARTER HOLT SAYS PRICES IMPROVING IN Q2.

text.p: Carter Holt Harvey Ltd said on Thursday market conditions continued to erode productivity gains and cost reductions over the first quarter but a number of its markets were beginning to improve from cyclical lows.
"However, the fundamentals for several of the company's businesses are strengthening and modest price improvements have been achieved in the second quarter," CHH said.
"Over the coming quarter the company will step up and accelerate its initiatives to improve its returns from all businesses," CHH said.
CHH, a pulp, paper and packaging manufacturer just over half-owned by International Paper, earlier reported a first quarter net profit of NZ$49 million, down from $56 million a year earlier.
Market expectations were for a net profit of NZ$45-50 million.
